mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs and increased liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0% in a month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing supply chain disruptions (INDPRO below 100 for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in reduced production capacity and inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO has been below 100 for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher real rates pressure equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% YoY, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 6 months indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS has increased for 6 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1600 thousand units in a month, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and overall demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where HOUST falls below 1600 thousand units, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 102 for 3 consecutive months indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profits and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO has been above 102 for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
